name: Residence Permit for Study Purposes

requirements.blocker_text: Enrollment certificate (or, for first-time applicants, an acceptance letter) from an accredited Romanian institution in a full-time program.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to an accredited Romanian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of funds at least equal to the guaranteed national minimum gross wage, held for a period of at least 6 months.
Must first enter Romania on a long-stay study visa (obtained via a Romanian consulate, fee EUR 300) before applying for the residence permit in-country.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a long-stay study visa at a Romanian consulate.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial means (6 months at minimum wage level)

outcome.duration_length: matches the length of the study program; extendable up to 9 months post-graduation for job-seeking or business setup

sources.title: General Inspectorate for Immigration (IGI), Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs -- residence permit for study purposes: enrollment, EUR 300 long-stay study visa fee, 6-month minimum-wage-level financial proof, part-time work capped at 6 hours/day, 9-month post-graduation extension for job search/business setup, scholarship holders and ethnic Romanians exempt from certain fees

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Romania). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 sourced to IGI (the Ministry of Internal Affairs' immigration authority), with concrete, specific figures (EUR 300 visa fee, 6-hour/day part-time work cap, 9-month post-study extension window). work_rights is set to 'restricted' (not 'full') because the source explicitly caps part-time work at 6 hours/day for permit holders -- this is a genuine, sourced limitation, not a conservative default. family_can_join/family_can_work are set false as the source's page did not describe a dependent-of-student track; this is disclosed as a gap rather than asserted from unaided knowledge. The EUR 300 long-stay study visa fee is paid at the issuing consulate BEFORE the in-country residence permit application described here -- modeled as a hard prerequisite requirement of this route rather than a separate file, since it is a single continuous process per the source.
